definition.name: Observe original signed Java fiber failure without rebuilding the guest

steps.name: Test immutable input and observation selection guards
Retrieve only the fixed original failed-run artifact
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-fiber-origin"
timeout 90s gh api repos/KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric/actions/runs/44518163237 | head -c 1048577 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-fiber-origin/run.json"
timeout 90s gh api repos/KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric/actions/jobs/135539652265 | head -c 1048577 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-fiber-origin/job.json"
timeout 90s gh api repos/KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric/actions/artifacts/14527262956 | head -c 1048577 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-fiber-origin/artifact.json"
timeout 120s gh api repos/KirilsTurkins/latent-service-fabric/actions/artifacts/14527262956/zip | head -c 75006715 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-fiber-origin/artifact.zip"

steps.name: Authenticate and stage four original component inputs without a compiler
Restore compiled Rust dependencies without publishing diagnostic products
Run the unchanged signed test with the existing eight-frame numeric observer
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime \
  --features java-checkpoint-gc-trap-diagnostic --test local_service \
  runtime::signed_java_threads_spin_join_and_thread_local_use_real_activation_fibers -- \
  --ignored --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-fiber-fault/numeric-fault.log"

steps.name: Retain bounded original inputs and numeric fault evidence
